title: Scaffold a runnable composition root that boots the shell

title.description: Product display title. Defaults to a title-cased name.

styles.description: Which stylesheet to emit. 'tailwind' compiles the shell's source theme and lets you write Tailwind utilities of your own; 'precompiled' imports the stylesheet we compiled, so the application needs no Tailwind and can be themed with Bootstrap or anything else.

force.description: Compose into the application already at that path, replacing the bootstrap files this scaffold owns and merging its build targets. Without it an existing project is an error.

directory.description: Project root, relative to the workspace root.

tags.description: Comma-separated Nx tags for the project.

prefix.description: Selector prefix for generated components and directives.

unitTestRunner.description: Test wiring to emit. 'vitest' uses @nx/angular:unit-test; 'none' emits no test target.
